pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions are structured as irregular polygons with varying edge angularity. Neck patches exhibit smoother pixel gradients and elongated geometries, while shoulder/flank patches show sharper edge definitions and larger relative spatial areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light negative-space pathways form a continuous topological grid. Pathways exhibit relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible area, with junction nodes primarily consisting of three-way and four-way intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a short, bristly line along the dorsal neck ridge with low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness against the background.
